walkthroughs.body_html:
Fundamentals Of Computer Systems — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Fundamentals Of Computer Systems brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Fundamentals Of Computer Systems.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which is a high-level programming language?
options: Assembly
Machine code
Python
Binary
Internet Data Engine
Integrated Development Environment
Internal Debugging Editor
Interpreted Dynamic Executable

mcqs.q: What is the main advantage of asymmetric encryption?
options: They produce different programming languages.
It is impossible to break.
It is faster than symmetric encryption.
Secure key exchange without sharing a secret in advance.

mcqs.q: What is the key difference between a compiler and an interpreter?
options: They produce different programming languages.
A compiler is a person, an interpreter is software.
It is impossible to break.
A compiler translates the whole program first; an interpreter executes line by line.

mcqs.q: Why must a recursive function have a base case?
options: It is impossible to break.
Because the syntax requires it.
Without it, the function calls itself indefinitely, causing a stack overflow.
To make the function run faster.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Comment”?
options: Assembly or machine code, closer to hardware, providing direct control of the processor.
Integrated Development Environment: editor, compiler/interpreter, debugger and tools combined in one application.
Non-executing text in source code that explains the program to human readers.
Set of rules defining valid combinations of symbols and keywords in a programming language.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “IDE”?
options: Programming language close to human language (Python, Java) that must be translated to machine code.
Non-executing text in source code that explains the program to human readers.
Set of rules defining valid combinations of symbols and keywords in a programming language.
Integrated Development Environment: editor, compiler/interpreter, debugger and tools combined in one application.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Syntax”?
options: Set of rules defining valid combinations of symbols and keywords in a programming language.
Integrated Development Environment: editor, compiler/interpreter, debugger and tools combined in one application.
Assembly or machine code, closer to hardware, providing direct control of the processor.
Meaning of a syntactically valid program - what the code actually does when executed.
